heading: Research and teaching
lead: His research interest is “relationships” in business. It runs through seven areas.

areas.name: Workforce motivation
areas.description: Employees at different levels of an organisation.

areas.name: Behavioural channel theory
areas.description: The relationship between channels and the organisations that use them.

areas.name: International marketing strategy
areas.description: Cross-cultural relationships, such as those between brands across national boundaries.

areas.name: Brand management
areas.description: The relationship between consumers and brands.

areas.name: Ethics
areas.description: The relationship between the individual, the organisation and society.

notes.heading: Teaching and talks
notes.text: The institute says he has taught or presented research at institutions in North America, Europe and Asia, and speaks on branding, employee motivation, ethics and international business.

notes.heading: Publications
notes.text: The institute's profile credits him with over 100 articles in journals and conference proceedings.
